visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands gently tears apart a loaf of golden-brown honey yogurt toast, revealing its soft, fibrous, and fluffy white interior texture. The bread sits on a circular wooden tray atop a stone-textured surface. The background features warm natural light filtering through window blinds next to a potted plant. (2) The hands press down firmly into a large, pale white dough that has risen significantly inside a deep stainless steel mixing bowl, demonstrating the fermented dough's elasticity and airy softness. The lighting is bright and clear, highlighting the smooth surface of the ingredient. (3) On a white marble countertop, the hands are seen dividing and rolling pieces of dough into smooth, round balls. Several dough balls are already prepared in the background, along with a white plastic dough scraper and a rolling pin used for portioning and shaping. (4) The hands showcase two black, square-shaped metal toast molds by lifting one out of the other. The molds are matte black and positioned on the marble surface, indicating they are ready for the dough pieces to be placed inside. (5) Using a small rolling pin, the hands flatten a piece of dough into an oval shape before rolling it tightly into a cylinder. This rolling process is repeated for multiple dough portions visible on the counter to prepare them for the mold. (6) A metal spoon is used to spread cooked red beans onto a flattened rectangular piece of dough. The hands then carefully roll the dough up, encasing the red bean filling to create a swirled flavor variation of the base toast. (7) The hands place the prepared dough rolls into the black square molds. The view then shifts to show several molds filled with dough that has fermented and risen to fill about eighty percent of the containers' height. (8) Wearing gray textured heat-resistant oven mitts, the hands remove a freshly baked, square-shaped golden toast from the oven. The toast is turned out onto a metal cooling rack, displaying a perfectly uniform browned crust on all sides. (9) The finished toast products, including the red bean variety, are sliced and torn open by hand. The inner crumb looks incredibly soft and moist, with the purple-red bean filling distributed in a marble pattern, accompanied by final text overlays.
